text: If you're about to buy him another Christmas gift that's just going to sit in a drawer, don't. If he's always fixing something, working on his car, or spending time in the garage, this is something he'll actually use. And with Black Friday deals already starting, it's a pretty good time to grab one. This little work light puts out up to 1,500 lumens and lights up dark, hard-to-reach spots fast. It has a built-in magnet, adjusts up to 180 degrees, rotates 360, and has three brightness settings, a flashlight mode, and a hook, so you can keep both hands free. There's also a battery indicator on the back, and it charges with Type-C. It's great for working on the car, camping, fishing, off-roading, or pretty much anywhere you need extra light. It's compact, easy to keep around, and one of those tools that ends up getting used way more than you expect. If the Black Friday deal is still down there, check it out before the price changes.
